mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE tree (id, depth, ordering) AS ( SELECT id, 0, ARRAY [sort_order::bigint, id] FROM iam_menu_item WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT m.id, t.depth + 1, t.ordering || ARRAY [m.sort_order::bigint, m.id] FROM iam_menu_item m JOIN tree t ON m.parent_id = t.id WHERE t.depth < 1000) SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, m.type, m.code, m.name, m.path, m.sort_order, m.permission_code, m.enabled, m.version FROM tree t JOIN iam_menu_item m ON m.id = t.id ORDER BY t.ordering
